Callout.Name: Stab Wound
Callout.Message: Person stabbed, wound to the abdomen.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, suspect gone, caller on scene.

Script.Line: Outside the takeaway. It took two seconds.
I have a jacket over it. Somebody told me to hold the jacket.
Is that much blood normal? Somebody answer me.

Callout.Patient: It does not hurt as much as it should. Is that bad?

Lines.Approach: Stabbed in the stomach and still talking, which is not the same as being all right.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
